content: For patients presenting with severe albuminuria (defined as urinary albumin excretion ≥ 300 mg/g) or a significant decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), the American Diabetes Association (ADA) strongly recommends frequent referrals to nephrology specialists and consistent monitoring of renal function. In cases where eGFR falls below 30 mL/min/1.73 m², prioritization of specialist care is advised to ensure advanced management of the condition.
